fields.objection: LIT-STIFF treats the 759,000 and 754,000 lb predictions as conflicting source values.
fields.evidence: STA8.1 PDF p4 distinguishes geometry refinement from the additional nonuniform-loading refinement. Relative errors against 743,000 lb are 2.153% and 1.480%.
fields.proposed_fix: Assign separate model identities to the two predictions. Flag the intermediate model's incorrect 1.5% prose label. Clarify total versus web stiffener height instead of declaring an unexplained geometry contradiction.
fields.disposition: Record for owner revision; check completed
